expires_tomorrow.title: Bundle - Indie Fears
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Get into the spooky season with this new bundle of the creepiest indie games around! Discover what all the fuss is about with the much-memed space-set nightmare fuel game Mouthwashing. Keep a mystery train running and try not to run out of oxygen on the steep mountain slopes of Threshold. Flip burgers and keep your customers satisfied in the spooky cooking simulator send-up Kiosk. Those aren’t even the tip of the horror game iceberg featured in this bundle, so name your price and help support the Prevent Cancer Foundation charity with your purchase. And maybe keep a light on while you play. You never know.

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 14th, 2027.

expires_within_72h.title: Software Engineering 2026
expires_within_72h.long_description:
Curious about Claude Coding, machine learning, and the latest industry-leading tech trends? Our latest bundle offers the professional-quality instruction you need! Simplify your digital workload and harness the power of AI with elite learning courses like Intro to Agentic Coding with Claude Code, SaaS App with Python - Stripe Integration, Agentic AI with Claude Code & MCP, and more. Pay what you want for the very best from Zenva, and help support Alzheimer's Research UK while you learn with Humble Bundle!

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before November 02, 2027.

expires_within_72h.title: Cozy After Dark Showcase Bundle
expires_within_72h.long_description:
Have some after hours fun with this bundle of cozy games set in the middle of the night! Follow a new vampire navigating a 19th century Eastern European town in Cabernet! Sneak into school at night and survive a botched séance in Fear the Spotlight! Help trapped souls in the afterlife and guide them toward closure in the emotional Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo! There’s even more atmospheric fun to be had in this bundle of cozy nighttime games, so grab them all now at the price of your choosing, and support Dames 4 Games with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 2nd, 2027.

expires_within_72h.title: World Builders: Horrors and Haunts
expires_within_72h.long_description:
Give your games the spooky atmospheres and creepy environments they deserve with this giant bundle of horror game digital assets from Dekogon Studios! This collection of buildings, furniture, statues, and more features churches in which to set unearthly rituals, enormous castles for dragons or vampires to call home, post-apocalyptic apartment complexes, definitely haunted mansions, suburban homes perfect for some slasher fun, and more! Build your games, fill them with frights, and let your story take hold with this asset bundle, available at the price of your choosing! Pay what you want and support the Forest School Foundation with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before December 31, 2027.

expires_within_72h.title: Excel by Wiley
expires_within_72h.long_description: Ready to woo your team with the sharpest Excel skills in the office? We’ve got you covered with an approachable bundle of ebooks on Excel and the greater Microsoft 365 suite! Jam‑packed with titles from the iconic For Dummies series like Microsoft 365 Excel Formulas & Functions For Dummies, 7th Edition and Excel Data Analysis For Dummies, 5th Edition, this amazing bundle by Wiley covers a wide range of beginner and intermediate topics to help meet you at your existing skill level. Experience Excel’s everyday power of simple data organization, powerful calculations, and more while helping to support Kiss the Ground when you learn with Humble Bundle.
